name: Zen Technologies Limited
summary: Zen Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of training simulators in India and internationally. It provides anti-drone systems; training and simulation live ranges, comprising smart and multi-functional target systems, tank targets, master control station for live-firing ranges, air-to-ground firing range scoring system, containerized tubular and indoor shooting range, shoot house for live and simulated indoor tactical training, special purpose adapter for hand guns, cornershot weapon system, tank zeroing system, and containerized small arms firing range; armour combat training, indoor tracking, hand grenade simulator, …
